title: Absolute wall-clock assertions that may flake on a loaded machine (an elapsed-time toBeLessThan on Date.now or performance.now)
evidence: US-71 AC12 (2026-11-26). Growth or ratio, each shown to fail on a reintroduced slow path: widget-src/src/lib/docx-extract.test.ts expectLinear (unclosed tags, cell closes, nesting past the cap, nested rows round a long text) and the merged-column case against a one-word note; scripts/guide-compare.test.ts; app/lib/router-view.test.ts N1; tools/merge-batch.test.ts pre-flight (8x lines). Exact instead of timed: packages/health-core/src/dropbox-rest.test.ts checks AbortSignal.timeout(20). A bound under the fault's 30 s with its reason: tools/mac-slot.test.ts PROMPT_MS; tools/wait-run.test.ts and tools/merge-gated.test.ts hang cuts (20 s, 15 s). A generous cost bound with its measured time: packages/health-core/src/upload-view.rulings.test.ts, ios/engine/upload-doors.test.ts. Already exact on a fake clock, left: app/lib/app-routes.server.test.ts:694, app/lib/anthropic.server.retry.test.ts:302. Lower bounds only, which load cannot break: app/routes/mcp.hosted.test.ts:1926; widget-src/src/hooks/useHighlights.test.tsx:361 (a deliberate real-clock pin, though its waitFor timeouts can still run out under load). Left: ios/scripts/sim-run.test.ts:322 (unsure whether 'about a second' is the claim or a backstop), :745 (the 7 s bound is the fault's own minimum, so it cannot widen without an injected clock in the script), :463 :950 :964 :979 :1002 (hang backstops at 2 to 4x the run limit; not yet checked fault by fault); tools/wait-run.test.ts:550 :559 :573 (poll deadlines for a stub to start, 10 s, and a 5 s exit bound against a 120 s fault). Earlier: US-32 AC58 (PR 1656), the scrubber and blood-pressure growth tests. Rule: docs/gotchas.md 2026-11-13
